objective: Add Ctrl+drag panning that raycasts the pointer against the terrain mesh and keeps the selected terrain point projected under the pointer during dragging.

assumptions.camera_space: Viewer camera and terrain are handled in normalized WebGL scene coordinates.
assumptions.refined_mesh: When adaptive refinement is active, the refined blended mesh is used for ray intersection.
assumptions.regular_mesh: When refinement is inactive, regular blended grid triangles are used.
assumptions.fallback: If no terrain intersection is found or the projection solve fails, existing screen-space pan is used.

inputs.pointer: Mouse client coordinates transformed to normalized device coordinates.
inputs.camera: Current MVP matrix and its inverse.
terrain_mesh: current.refined_mesh layer from refinedLayerId() when active

outputs.ui_hint: drag: rotate | wheel: zoom | shift+drag: pan | ctrl+drag: terrain pan

crs.input_crs: Unchanged from loaded viewer experiment, normally EPSG:3857
crs.crs_inference: No new geospatial input was introduced.

rasterization.resolution: Unchanged; uses the already-loaded viewer mesh resolution
rasterization.aggregation_rule: Unchanged; minimum z for Cloud DEM rasterization in the project pipeline
rasterization.validity_mask: Finite cells in the selected blended surface

metrics.formula: Not applicable for this UI interaction change.
